cohort: Women scheduled for elective caesarean sections at PAF Hospital Faisal, Karachi, from February 2023 to July 2023, excluding those with medical or surgical comorbidities or who had emergency or urgent caesarean sections.
finding: The ERAS protocol significantly reduced post-operative hospital stay compared to conventional care (33.42 vs. 61.30 hours, p=0.001).
followup_time: Duration of hospital stay (approximately 1.4 days for ERAS and 2.6 days for conventional care)
